stage: v27 recovery eligibility independent of notification sampling

excluded_wrong_profile_acquisitions.label: baselineburst
excluded_wrong_profile_acquisitions.reason: Controller replacement expected the older256-packet template; the actual template was1024,so the2048 replacement did not apply. Captures retained,case excluded; fixed controller checks both rendered rule and live nft JSON before load.

excluded_wrong_profile_acquisitions.label: candidateburst
excluded_wrong_profile_acquisitions.reason: Controller replacement expected the older256-packet template; the actual template was1024,so the2048 replacement did not apply. Captures retained,case excluded; fixed controller checks both rendered rule and live nft JSON before load.

bounds.workspace: one reusable current-batch arena and slice headers; payload size bounded by the selected attempt,at most2MiB extra transient storage; typical128x204bytes about25.5KiB; retained ciphertext never mutated

method.traffic: 25000 noise datagrams/s for 70s,64 ports at one IPv4; useful UDP 6000/s with 128-byte payload for 60s requested. Both download and upload tested; complete inner captures count unique UDP datagrams with GSO/GRO.
method.WAN: RTT300ms,jitter30ms per direction; half RTT each A-B direction including control channel. Netem queue16384,no configured random loss;20 physical pings before each case.
method.movement: Client gateway changes IP/NAT port only;3 changes250ms apart after prior conntrack deletion,or2 IP-only changes. Actual spans retained. Client binaries,profiles,keys and native listen ports unchanged.
method.pairing: Same netem seeds and workload per condition. AB then BA order for two triple-move pairs; IP pair AB and upload cost pair BA. Timing and GSO grouping can still change effective delay draws; no statistical guarantee.
method.admission_diagnostic: A further AB upload pair keeps the same source rate1500/s,source burst4096,aggregate rate6000/s and workload,raising only the temporary aggregate burst1024 to2048. Recovery budgets and public defaults unchanged. This is not a distributed-noise safety qualification.
method.deadline: Unchanged1s;100 ordinary probes perprofile at500ms plus100 frequent probes at50ms. Same-clock client captures verify late RTT; application receive lag separate.
method.regression: The new retry-before-notification subtest fails against v26 logic; the candidate recovers once with notification eligibility held false,does not rearm on stationary transport,and leaves Unix notifications rate-limited.
method.timing: Endpoint/attempt journald timestamps approximate; internal send duration monotonic. Approximate eligibility subtracts only known endpoint availability and previous250ms attempt spacing; it does not prove the exact cause of every remaining wait.
method.fabric: Four connected lab Ethernet TCP ports required before/after every case; zero switch-drop delta. No host network changes. Builds and race tests complete before traffic.

limits: One moving native peer plus a stationary control; GUI apps,DPI,multiple moving peers,distributed noise and state exhaustion remain untested.
Removing the notification gate does not remove endpoint authentication,WAN propagation,vanished NAT mappings or the250ms recovery budget. A1s response deadline remains unguaranteed.
The upload pair measures6000pps receive-path overhead with the same outer captures in both variants; this is not a maximum-throughput benchmark or a higher-PPS result.
Shared budgets,expiry and ciphertext replay constraints are unchanged. Recovery is experimental,off by default; bounded amplification and ciphertext linkability remain.
